summary_en: 351,600 shares to be issued at exchange ratio of 879:1; target Yōkō is Duskin franchise operator in Chiba; effective 2026-10-01; simplified exchange procedure (no shareholder vote required for parent); funded by treasury stock.
title_en: Notice Regarding Complete Subsidiary Acquisition of Kabushiki Kaisha Yōkō via Simplified Stock Exchange
translation_en_brief: Nack announced on 2026-08-28 that its board approved acquisition of Yōkō (Kabushiki Kaisha Yōkō), a Duskin franchise operator, via simplified stock exchange effective 2026-10-01. Under the transaction, Nack will issue 351,600 of its common shares at an exchange ratio of 879:1, funded entirely by treasury stock. Yōkō will become a wholly owned subsidiary. The transaction qualifies as simplified exchange under Japanese Corporate Law Article 796(2) because Yōkō's net assets represent less than 10% of Nack's and its sales less than 3% of Nack's, so Nack's shareholders do not require to approve the transaction (though Yōkō shareholders must approve at a special meeting on 2026-08-28). The exchange ratio was determined with reference to an independent valuation by Clifix FAS; the firm used market-price method for Nack (TSE-listed) and DCF method for Yōkō (unlisted). Nack stated the acquisition strengthens its operational base in Chiba prefecture and supports further growth in the Duskin franchise business, which is a core pillar of the Nack group. The ratio is subject to revision if material conditions change.
